newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $2 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $2 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, August 5, were expected to total $2 billion in 43 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings totalled $1.2 billion in 19 sales, with a $300 million New York City Water Financing Authority offering through PaineWebber Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 24 sales totaling $735 million were scheduled. A $240 million Georgia offering at 1100 EDT was the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $347 million were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
